description: Set-level message flagging - the bridge's single privileged operation, because the WebExtension API has no bulk flag update.

functions.name: markMessages
functions.description: Mark messages read and/or flagged using the folder-level operations Thunderbird's own UI uses: ids are grouped per folder and each folder gets one set-level call, not one per message. Message ids are the WebExtension ids from the current session; all ids resolve before anything is marked, so a single unknown id marks nothing and names itself in the error.
